# neomodel classes for Neo4j 5: one StructuredNode per node label, RelationshipTo and
# RelationshipFrom for the relationships. Create the constraints and indexes with
# neomodel_install_labels <this file> --db bolt://user:password@host:7687
# (or db.install_labels(Class) in your code). Foreign key columns stay as plain properties.

from uuid import uuid4

from neomodel import (
    BooleanProperty,
    DateTimeProperty,
    IntegerProperty,
    JSONProperty,
    One,
    RelationshipFrom,
    RelationshipTo,
    StringProperty,
    StructuredNode,
    ZeroOrMore,
    ZeroOrOne,
)


class Category(StructuredNode):
    """Model Category (table blog_category)."""

    id_ = IntegerProperty(unique_index=True, required=True, db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True)
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True)
    name = StringProperty(max_length=100, unique_index=True, required=True)
    slug = StringProperty(max_length=50, required=True)
    parent_id = IntegerProperty()
    parent = RelationshipTo("Category", "PARENT", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)
    children = RelationshipFrom("Category", "PARENT", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    posts = RelationshipFrom("Post", "CATEGORY", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)


class Post(StructuredNode):
    """Model Post (table blog_post)."""

    id_ = IntegerProperty(unique_index=True, required=True, db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True)
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True)
    public_id = StringProperty(unique_index=True, default=lambda: str(uuid4()))
    title = StringProperty(max_length=200, index=True, required=True)
    body = StringProperty(required=True)
    status = StringProperty(
        choices={"draft": "DRAFT", "published": "PUBLISHED"},
        index=True,
        default="draft",
    )
    rating = StringProperty()
    view_count = IntegerProperty(default=0)
    is_featured = BooleanProperty(default=False)
    published_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, index=True)
    metadata = JSONProperty(required=True)
    author_id = IntegerProperty(index=True, required=True)
    editor_id = IntegerProperty()
    category_id = IntegerProperty(required=True)
    author = RelationshipTo("User", "AUTHOR", cardinality=One)
    editor = RelationshipTo("User", "EDITOR", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)
    category = RelationshipTo("Category", "CATEGORY", cardinality=One)
    tags = RelationshipTo("Tag", "TAGS", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)


class Tag(StructuredNode):
    """Model Tag (table blog_tag)."""

    id_ = IntegerProperty(unique_index=True, required=True, db_property="id")
    label = StringProperty(max_length=50, required=True)
    posts = RelationshipFrom("Post", "TAGS", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)


class Profile(StructuredNode):
    """Model Profile (table blog_profile)."""

    id_ = IntegerProperty(unique_index=True, required=True, db_property="id")
    bio = StringProperty()
    avatar = StringProperty(max_length=100)
    user_id = IntegerProperty(unique_index=True, required=True)
    user = RelationshipTo("User", "USER", cardinality=One)


class User(StructuredNode):
    """Model User (table auth_user)."""

    id_ = IntegerProperty(unique_index=True, required=True, db_property="id")
    posts = RelationshipFrom("Post", "AUTHOR", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    edited_posts = RelationshipFrom("Post", "EDITOR", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    profile = RelationshipFrom("Profile", "USER", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)
